prompt:
Create ONE photorealistic vertical 9:16 product-review opening. REFERENCE 1 is product crop; REFERENCE 2 is canonical adult identity. Exactly ONE palm-sized pastel lavender power bank matching product reference: thick rounded rectangular rigid smooth shell, glossy BLACK rounded rectangular level window at one end of the broad front face, original white level markings, one short matching lavender loop and original seam. Preserve shell/window/loop proportions and relative positions. Never add cables, extra loops, new ports, brand names or accessories. The loop is a strap, not a charging cable. Keep original front facing the camera; no rear or hidden-edge reconstruction.
The exact fictional adult woman from canonical reference: chin-length side-part black bob, softly angular face, sage-green long-sleeve shirt. Same face, hair and clothing throughout, normal five-finger hands, relaxed closed lips; separate male voice-over later.
Bright modern home workspace, off-white desk, pale blue wall, small blurred leafy plant and closed plain notebook well away from product. Fixed large diffuse studio lights at 5200K, no visible window, no moving sunlight, no signage, consistent neutral exposure.
Medium upper-body portrait with face fully visible and product prominent on supporting LEFT palm at chest height. Whole product and short loop visible; right fingertips beside blank shell ready to touch. Product occupies about 20% of frame height, comfortable palm-sized scale.
No added text anywhere: no captions, subtitles, titles, cards, watermark, readable background signs or invented product lettering. Preserve only intrinsic product markings. No collage or graphic layout.
